name: Windows Agent Arena
description: Windows Agent Arena is a scalable, reproducible benchmark environment for evaluating multi-modal agents operating within a real Windows OS. It includes 150+ diverse tasks requiring planning, screen understanding, and tool usage, enabling fast and parallelized evaluation of agent performance in realistic multi-modal scenarios.
reputation: A notable and increasingly used benchmark for real-world computer-use agents, especially for evaluating multimodal interaction with a live Windows environment.
notes: Benchmark runs on real Windows OS with diverse tasks; evaluation can be parallelized for fast results.
